# 1-day 2x iron fly on positive-gamma days, re-cut at 2016: SPY and QQQ (2026-09-29)

## Pre-registration (written BEFORE any 2016+ return was computed; do not edit this section after the results)

**Why.** Audit List A #4 (`audit_top_down_2026-09-25.md`). The QQQ replication (`gex_qqq_ironfly_2026-09-22.md`)
failed at t 2.55 with its first half negative (−5.05%). Named defect: the failing half is mostly the pre-2016 era,
when neither ETF had regular next-day expiries, so the "1-day fly" existed only on scattered days. The question is
whether the trade holds in the era where it can actually be traded every week. The SPY fly is being paper-traded now.

**⚠ Honest caveat, stated up front.** The 2016 cut is chosen *after* seeing that the pre-2016 QQQ half lost. The
structural reason is real (checked on counts only, before this doc: w = 2 positive-gamma flies per year were
5–19 for SPY and 7–33 for QQQ pre-2016, vs 34–147 after), but the cut is still informed by the outcome. That is why
the bar is raised and the ceiling is SUPPORTED, not certified.

**Data.** The existing trade-level outputs, unchanged: `gex_spy_ironfly_2026-09-21.csv`,
`gex_qqq_ironfly_2026-09-22.csv` (engine `run_gex_spy_ironfly.py`, real fills: shorts mid − 25% BA, longs mid + 25%,
$0.0065/sh/leg, settle at expiry). No re-run of the engine.

**Primary (per ticker).** w = 2.0, positive prior-close own-GEX days, day ≥ 2016-01-01 (to 2026-02).
Return on max risk. PASS per ticker = mean > 0, **t ≥ 3.2 on days**, both halves positive (split **2021-01-01**:
2016–2020 / 2021–2026), and positive-gamma > negative-gamma mean.
**Charge:** second look at each ticker's fly (k = 2, Šidák on the |t| ≥ 3 bar → 3.2).

**Reading.** Both tickers pass → the fly is SUPPORTED on two underlyings in the tradeable era; QQQ joins the paper
trade. SPY only → nothing changes (paper trade stays SPY-only). SPY fails → the SPY paper trade's historical basis
rests on pre-2016 days and should be flagged WEAKENED further.

**Reported, exploratory only:** month-clustered t (sum of $ P&L by month); weekday-only entries (excluding Fri→Mon,
the audit showed SPY's full-sample pass needs them); per-year means; worst day $.

**Not tested:** w = 1.0, other wing widths, any gate other than the sign, other tickers.

---

## Results (run 2026-09-29, after the pre-registration above was committed in 17b8fc6; `run_gex_fly_2016_recut.py`, `.log`, `.csv`)

**Verdict: QQQ PASS → SUPPORTED (not certified; the 2016 cut was outcome-informed). SPY FAIL narrowly (t 3.01 < 3.2)
→ per the pre-registered reading, the SPY fly is WEAKENED further: in the tradeable era it is no stronger than QQQ's.**

w = 2.0, 2016-01 → 2026-02, return on max risk at the real fill, halves split 2021-01-01:

| | n | mean | t (bar 3.2) | 2016–20 (t, n) | 2021–26 (t, n) | month-clustered t | NEG days | weekday-only POS |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **QQQ POS** | 599 | **+8.07%** | **3.64** | +8.95% (1.85, 102) | +7.89% (3.17, 497) | 3.17 | −6.51% (t −3.00) | +8.02% t 3.35 |
| **SPY POS** | 857 | +5.44% | **3.01** | +2.68% (0.94, 349) | +7.34% (3.15, 508) | 3.67 | −5.15% (t −2.65) | +4.40% t 2.12 |

- QQQ positive-gamma years 2016–2026: **11/11 positive** (+1.6% to +25.6%). SPY: 9/11 (2018 −7.9%, 2022 −1.2%).
- The gamma sign carries everything on both tickers: ALL-days ≈ 0 (+0.14% / +0.19%), POS and NEG mirror each other.
- QQQ does not need the Fri→Mon entries (weekday-only t 3.35); SPY does (weekday-only t 2.12, as the audit found).
- ⚠ QQQ's first half is thin and weak on its own (n 102, t 1.85); the pass rests on 2021+ (n 497). Worst QQQ day −$1,004
  per fly, SPY −$709.
- **Check run before believing the pass:** settlement uses raw 1-min closes; they match option-implied spot within
  ~0.1% across 2010–2025 on both tickers, so no split/dividend-adjustment artefact.

**What it means for the book now.** Today's tape is negative-gamma, so neither fly fires today. When gamma flips
positive, the evidence now favours **QQQ at least as much as SPY**. Per the pre-registered reading, QQQ should join the
paper trade (`run_gex_fly_paper.py`, currently SPY-only), still with no size: it is SUPPORTED, not certified.
